## Summary

The IEEE registry lists one MA-L block to "Huaqin Telecom Technology Co.,Ltd" and two to "Shanghai Huaqin Telecom Technology Co.,Ltd", both at 399 Keyuan Road in Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park, Pudong, Shanghai [1], and four MA-M blocks to "Huaqin Telecom Technology Co.,Ltd." at Building 1, 399 Keyuan Road [2]. Caixin described Huaqin Telecom Technology in 2019 as a Shanghai-based original design manufacturer founded in 2005 that designs and makes phones for smartphone brands, with Huawei, Xiaomi and Oppo as main customers, and that had expanded into notebooks and IoT products since 2016 [3]. The company now presents itself as Huaqin Technology, founded in 2005, headquartered in Shanghai and listed as 603296.SH and 03296.HK; that it is the same company is inferred from the shared name, city and founding year [3][4].

A MAC in these blocks is most likely a phone, tablet, laptop or wearable sold under another brand, since Huaqin builds to order: Digitimes reported that it led global ODM and IDH smartphone shipments in 2021 with a 31 percent share, shipped more than 200 million smartphones, notebooks and tablets that year, began smartphone ODM work for Samsung in 2019, and counts Samsung, Oppo, Xiaomi, Vivo, Amazon, Lenovo, LG Electronics, Acer, Asustek and Sony as clients [5].

Radios, silicon, FCC grantee codes and security history are not documented by the sources consulted; the FCC ID databases refused automated access from this session. The registry's separate "Huaqin Technology" spellings are not listed as aliases here because no fetched source states the rename.
